verdict.rationale: Svelte ships first-party state management inside the framework itself. Its documented runes ($state, $state.raw, $derived, $effect) handle reactive state, and .svelte.js/.svelte.ts modules are documented as the way to share reactive state across an app. A community user also praises Svelte Stores and the Context system for sharing state. This is built into the framework rather than a separately versioned library, but it is clearly official and maintained alongside the framework. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Svelte Stores module in the pack, documented guidance on app-wide or global store patterns, independent hands-on corroboration of runes-based shared state at scale.
